comment: A1 RELU PILOT (Stage 2, Step 7): ReLU-He and ReLU-RAI only, 20 seeds each, 2,000-epoch candidate budget. Used ONLY to (1) check the training budget with the approved training-loss plateau criterion and (2) calibrate the outcome thresholds. Pilot results are never research results. Seeds 0-19 are spent here; main runs must use a disjoint seed range. No DARL or LeakyReLU arm until the thresholds and budget are frozen.
name: relu-pilot
